Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> service=\"inference-prod\", incident=INC-4872, urgency=high, trigger=latency_p50>1200ms, at 2025-11-02T02:14:59Z
PagerDuty Bot: Page sent to escalation policy=platform-night-escalation, target=platform-oncall (user: ops-oncall)
Ken T: getting the page now. acked. odd — I'm on platform but this alert should go to inference-oncall.
Maria S: I see the same. Platform oncall is getting multiple inference pages. That doesn't match the PD binding in the runbook.
Lina V: pinging oncall slack: @ops-oncall are you seeing repeated latency alerts?
ops-oncall: yes, 6 pages in the last 10m. thought it was our stack. we don't own inference-prod.
Alex B: quick check — schedule-sync job ran at 02:10 UTC. last commit to schedule-sync: roll-forward to include night-shadow schedules. rolling back patch now.
Maria S: can we pause the PD binding to stop further fanout while we investigate?
PagerDuty Bot: Escalation policy platform-night-escalation paused by Maria S (manual action).
Ken T: confirmed no new pages after pause. but we need to fix routing so inference pages target inference-oncall. Root cause looks like a mismatched tag in the PD service mapping.
Alex B: found the mapping diff: in config repo `ops/pd/services.yml` the inference entry had `team: infernce` (typo) which matched a deprecated platform alias in the syncer. snippet:
```
- name: inference-prod
  service_key: xxxxx
  team: infernce  # <- typo, should be \"inference\"
```
Maria S: ah, so schedule-sync matched that misspelling to the shadow platform schedule. Good catch.
Lina V: action plan: 1) correct the typo in repo 2) restart schedule-sync 3) validate with a dry-run test page 4) re-enable escalation.
Alex B: pushing fix and running a dry-run. patch applied and schedule-sync restarted: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/schedule-sync-controller`
Alex B: dry-run command: `./tools/pd-dryrun --service inference-prod --escalation inference-night --dry-run` -> result: would target inference-oncall (expected).
Ken T: can we replay the alert to confirm? small test: send a synthetic alert with annotation `tests:reroute`
Maria S: do it now, keep platform escalation paused.
Alex B: `curl -X POST https://hooks.internal/alerts -d '{"service":"inference-prod","metric":"latency_p50","value":2000,"meta":{"test":"reroute"}}'`
PagerDuty Bot: Synthetic test alert created -> would route to inference-night-escalation -> target=inference-oncall. (dry-run mode)
ops-oncall: got no page.
Ken T: good. I'll re-enable inference escalation and unpause platform after one more verification.
Maria S: enabling inference-night-escalation. keep platform paused until 02:45UTC.
PagerDuty Bot: Escalation policy inference-night-escalation enabled by Ken T.
Ken T: monitoring for missed pages and customer impact. initial alert batch impacted internal latency dashboards only; no customer-facing error pages observed.
Lina V: checking customer metrics: error rate for inference features (prod) shows no spike, downstream queue depth steady. probable false positive amplification from a canary rollout causing transient latency.
Maria S: summary for now: immediate mitigation done (paused wrong escalation, fixed config typo, restarted sync, verified dry-run). No active customer impact found.
Alex B: follow-ups: 1) add a unit test in ops infra to validate team name strictness (no fuzzy match), 2) add a PD binding sanity check in schedule-sync to reject unknown team names, 3) runbook update to include steps to pause escalations + reroute.
Ken T: I'll own runbook update and the PD test case. Lina, can you own the triage note for postmortem?
Lina V: yep, will draft and add timeline + logs.
Maria S: also recommend an automated end-to-end pager test run weekly at midnight (low traffic) to catch binding regressions.
ops-oncall: thanks all — we will annotate our rotation to expect these tests.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-4872 marked mitigated at 2025-11-02T02:37:20Z by Ken T (manual).
Alex B: leaving a small audit log snippet for PD change: `git rev: a1b2c3 -> fixed infernce -> a1b2c4`
Ken T: closing thread here; will follow up with PM on customer impact note and file for retro. :thumbsup:
